event_records.description: The flight readiness review process for Apollo 11 is underway.

nasa_senior_managers.name: NASA Senior Managers
nasa_senior_managers.persona_brief:
You are NASA Senior Managers.
They are responsible for the Apollo 11 program and must decide whether to publicly announce a go decision for the July launch window after the flight readiness review. They have access to technical assessments and schedules, but the outcome of the review is not yet determined.

resolution.question: Will NASA's senior managers publicly announce a go decision for Apollo 11's July launch window at the conclusion of the flight readiness review process before the end of June 1969?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the cutoff, the persistent event history shows that NASA senior managers publicly announced a go decision for Apollo 11's July launch window. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
